4. CONFOUNDER ANALYSIS ENGINE (10 Deterministic Physics Filters)
1. DRS Active : Aerodynamic drag model distortion
2. Heavy Braking : Severe pitch & threshold transient dynamic
3. Full Throttle : Powertrain clipping & wheelspin limits
4. High Speed (>250kph): Aero sensitivity dominates tyre grip
5. Transient Jerk : Rapid d(throttle)/dt, d(brake)/dt spikes
6. Tyre Age : Fresh tyres (low lap prior) suppress false wear
7. Compound Type : Soft (rapid wear) vs Hard (linear decay)
8. Environmental Shift : Asphalt & air temp thermal gradient
9. Rainfall : Wet track hydrodynamic friction shift
10. Data Quality : Numerical jitter or outlier flags
(How much residual is explained by DRS, Aero, Braking)
